title: Salzburg Cathedral
source: Retained exact-QID way239345806 and current Protomaps parent/contained parts;two useful front/elevated exterior pictures.
identityStatus: Reviewed approximate current cathedral correspondence:west twin-tower front faces Domplatz at native-X,three rounded eastern/transept arms at native+X. Separate arcades and adjoining wings excluded.
axis: Native-X faces Domplatz and the three-portal/twin-tower west facade;native+X follows the nave toward the eastern rounded sanctuary;native+Z faces the southern rounded arm.

orientationControl.basis: The mapped pair of tall western towers/front panel and three eastern rounded arms resolve the undirected axis,matching front/elevated pictures. Raw outlines are preserved without rescaling.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Current parent gives the approximately 103x69m cathedral plan. Contained mapped parts give 28m aisle/service roofs,41m nave/crossing/rounded-arm tops,52m tower bodies with23/40/53m cornices,69m cupolas,78m tower lanterns plus79m cross tips,63m central dome and79m central lantern top. Photo-led internal estimates distinguish22m lower walls,36.5m nave/rounded-arm eaves,41..52m central drum,52..63m central dome,63..75.5m lantern and79m cross. Tower cupola stages53..61m and61..69m are inferred. Openings,roof profiles,facade bands,statues and floors are approximate;map heights are not a survey.
reconstruction.scope: Individual medium-fi cathedral exterior:staged twin west towers with clocks/open belfries/green cupolas/lanterns/crosses,three recessed closed entrance portals,layered pale facade with selected windows/pediments/pilasters/roofline figures,long dark nave/aisles,three rounded eastern/transept arms and roofs,and central octagonal drum/green dome/lantern. Exact sculpture/reliefs,full interiors,adjacent arcades/palace wings,plaza monuments and certified walking excluded.
